data.name: Heiskell
data.gender_notes: Heiskell is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Heiskell is derived from the Hebrew and Greek words, 'hesed' (loving-kindness, mercy, steadfastness) and 'kellos' (rock, foundation). This name signifies that God is the foundation and source of one's loving-kindness, mercy, and steadfastness. The name Heiskell carries the meaning “God is my rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Heiskell usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Heiskell total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
